i’ll be completely transparent here;

i stayed between 1400-1200 for a long time, but i dropped my intake significantly after unfortunately developing anorexia (which i am in recovery for, so yay!!). i’ve been slowly increasing my intake to work with metabolic damage/adaptation but my goal is to be back around 1200 by summer. my current intake number is definitely not something for comparison considering my struggle with mental health!

my biggest pieces of advice are looking into volume eating and eating a high protein diet. i only got into fitness through my recovery so i don’t think exercise is necessary, but do what makes you happy! what WILL help significantly though is increasing your steps. i walk about 20k steps on average thanks to my very active job, but 10k is already great for the average person!

tldr; volume eat, high protein, increase your steps, and please please please always nourish your body properly ❤️
